notes: A217738_div12 (A217738.lean, core): k(k+1) | fib k implies 12 | k (2 | fib n iff 3 | n; 3 | fib n iff 4 | n). Axioms propext, Quot.sound. The infinitude conjecture remains open (implied by infinitely many primes 2^a 3^b 5^c + 1 with a >= 2, b, c >= 1). Outside Lean: none.

sources.what: conjectures (infinite; 12 | all terms) listed without proof

prior_art.note: Divisibility by 12 is immediate from the periods of F mod 2 and mod 3; infinitude not settled.
